# Tokenizer Service

> CJK/Latin tokenizer HTTP API (ja / ko / zh / latin). Bearer auth. One-to-one `POST /api/tokens` → `{ "results": [...] }` (max 500). No batch endpoint.

This file is the AI / LLM integration reference. Served publicly at `GET /llms.txt` (no auth). Source of truth: this file + `src/`; if they disagree, trust the code.

## Docs

- [OpenAPI JSON](/api-docs/openapi.json): machine-readable OpenAPI schema
- [Swagger UI](/swagger-ui): interactive API explorer (Authorize with TOKENIZER_TOKEN)
- [Health](/health): liveness probe, plain text `ok`
- [Test page](/test): browser tokenize UI
- [Control panel](/): request stats dashboard

## Optional

- [README](https://github.com/siaikin/tokenizer-service/blob/main/README.md): human-oriented setup and usage

---

## 0. Quick facts

| Item | Value |
|------|--------|
| Role | HTTP CJK/Latin tokenizer (ja / ko / zh / latin) |
| Stack | Rust 2021 (MSRV 1.85), Axum 0.8, Tokio, SQLite (sqlx), Lindera, jieba-rs |
| Auth | `Authorization: Bearer <TOKENIZER_TOKEN>` |
| Tokenize API | **Only** `POST /api/tokens` |
| Removed | `POST /api/tokens/batch` — **do not call or reintroduce** unless explicitly requested |
| Contract | One-to-one: `texts[i]` → `results[i]` (same length always) |
| Max items | 500 per request |
| Output unit | Space-joined string per item (not a JSON array of tokens) |

---

## 1. MUST / MUST NOT

### When calling the API

- **MUST** send Bearer token on all `/api/*` routes except `GET /health`.
- **MUST** use body shape `{ "texts": [ { "<locale>": "<text>", ... }, ... ] }`.
- **MUST** expect `{ "results": ["...", ...] }` with `results.length === texts.length`.
- **MUST NOT** expect a single `tokens` string field (legacy; removed).
- **MUST NOT** call `/api/tokens/batch` (removed).
- **MUST NOT** assume token order inside one string is stable when a map has multiple locales (`HashMap` iteration order is undefined).
- **MUST NOT** assume CJK tokens are lowercased in the output string (only Latin is; dedupe is case-insensitive).

### When modifying the codebase

- **MUST** keep one-to-one semantics unless the user asks otherwise.
- **MUST** keep locale → engine mapping in `src/tokenize.rs` (`locale_kind`).
- **MUST NOT** re-bind API docs/comments to a specific downstream (e.g. Meilisearch) unless asked.
- **MUST NOT** add exploit/PoC code. Local vulnerability fixes only if requested.
- Prefer editing existing modules over new layers; match existing Chinese error/log style.

---

## 2. Auth & public routes

**Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <TOKENIZER_TOKEN>`  
Prefix must be exactly `Bearer ` (one space). Value compared to env `TOKENIZER_TOKEN` (constant-time).

| Path | Auth |
|------|------|
| `GET /health` | public → body `ok` (plain text) |
| `GET /` | public → control panel HTML |
| `GET /test` | public → test page HTML |
| `GET /swagger-ui`, `/api-docs/openapi.json` | public |
| `POST /api/tokens` | Bearer |
| `GET /api/admin/*`, `POST /api/admin/requests/{id}/cancel` | Bearer |

Missing/wrong token → `401` with body `{ "code": "UNAUTHORIZED", "message": "鉴权失败" }`.

---

## 3. `POST /api/tokens` — full contract

### 3.1 Request

```json
{
  "texts": [
    { "ja": "ガンダム", "zh-Hans": "高达" },
    { "en-US": "Mobile Suit" }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Type | Rules |
|-------|------|--------|
| `texts` | array of objects | Required; length ≥ 1 and ≤ 500 |
| object key | string (locale) | Selects tokenizer; **not** returned |
| object value | string | `trim()`; empty → skip that value |

**Validation (`400`, `code: BAD_REQUEST`):**

| Condition | `message` (contains) |
|-----------|----------------------|
| `texts` empty | `texts 不能为空` |
| `texts.len() > 500` | `texts 最多 500 条` |

Malformed JSON may surface as bad request via serde.

### 3.2 Success response (`200`)

```json
{
  "results": ["ガンダム 高达", "mobile suit"]
}
```

| Field | Invariant |
|-------|-----------|
| `results` | `Vec<String>`, **same length as `texts`** |
| `results[i]` | Tokens from `texts[i]` only; never merged across indices |
| Empty map / all-empty values | `results[i] === ""` (slot still present) |

**Response headers (success path only):**

| Header | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `x-request-id` | UUID of SQLite request log row |
| `x-duration-ms` | Tokenization wall time (ms) after status → running |

Error responses do **not** attach these headers (a DB row may still exist).

### 3.3 Locale → tokenizer

Locale is classified with `to_ascii_lowercase()` then:

| Match | Engine | Implementation |
|-------|--------|----------------|
| `ja` or `ja-*` | Japanese | Lindera embedded IPADIC |
| `ko` or `ko-*` | Korean | Lindera embedded ko-dic |
| starts with `zh`, or exact `cmn` | Chinese | jieba (`cut`, HMM off) |
| everything else | Latin | lowercase + split on `[^\p{L}\p{N}]+` |

Examples: `ja`, `ja-JP` → ja; `ko-KR` → ko; `zh`, `zh-Hans`, `zhHans` → zh; `en`, `en-US`, `fr` → latin.  
`jp` is **not** Japanese → latin.

### 3.4 Per-map algorithm (`tokens_from_map`)

For one `HashMap<String, String>`:

1. Iterate `(locale, raw)` pairs (**order undefined**).
2. `text = raw.trim()`; skip if empty.
3. Tokenize with engine for `locale`.
4. For each token: dedupe key = `token.to_lowercase()` via `BTreeSet`; if new, **push original `token`** (not the lowercased key).
5. Return `parts.join(" ")`.

**Engine notes:**

- **Latin:** input lowercased before split → emitted tokens are lowercase.
- **ja / ko:** Lindera `surface`; on failure → fall back to latin tokenizer (warn log).
- **zh:** jieba surfaces as-is (typically no Latin-style lowercasing).

**Implication:** README phrase “小写去重” means **case-insensitive dedupe**; output casing for CJK is **not** forced to lowercase.

### 3.5 Client pseudocode

```text
FUNCTION tokenize(baseUrl, bearerToken, texts):
  ASSERT texts.length >= 1 AND texts.length <= 500
  resp = HTTP POST baseUrl + "/api/tokens"
    headers: Authorization = "Bearer " + bearerToken
             Content-Type = application/json
    body: { "texts": texts }
  IF resp.status != 200:
    PARSE { code, message }; RAISE
  PARSE { results }
  ASSERT results.length == texts.length
  RETURN results
```

### 3.6 curl examples

```bash
# Health
curl -s http://localhost:8080/health

# Tokenize (one-to-one)
curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/tokens \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKENIZER_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"texts":[{"ja":"ガンダム","zh-Hans":"高达"},{"en-US":"Mobile Suit","zh-Hans":"机动战士"}]}'

# Empty values / empty map still yield aligned results
curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/tokens \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKENIZER_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"texts":[{"en":"Hello World"},{"ja":""},{}]}'
# → {"results":["hello world","",""]}
```

---

## 4. Admin APIs

All require Bearer.

### 4.1 `GET /api/admin/stats`

```json
{
  "total": 0,
  "queued": 0,
  "running": 0,
  "succeeded": 0,
  "failed": 0,
  "cancelled": 0,
  "avg_duration_ms": null,
  "total_output_chars": null
}
```

`avg_duration_ms` / `total_output_chars` derived from succeeded rows only (may be null).

### 4.2 `GET /api/admin/requests`

Query:

| Param | Default | Clamp |
|-------|---------|--------|
| `status` | omit = all | `queued` \| `running` \| `succeeded` \| `failed` \| `cancelled` |
| `limit` | `20` | 1–100 |
| `offset` | `0` | ≥ 0 |

Response:

```json
{
  "total": 1,
  "limit": 20,
  "offset": 0,
  "items": [ /* RequestRow */ ]
}
```

Order: `created_at DESC`.

### 4.3 `GET /api/admin/requests/{id}`

Path `{id}` = UUID (same as `x-request-id`).  
`404` if missing.

### 4.4 `POST /api/admin/requests/{id}/cancel`

```json
{ "cancelled": true, "message": "取消信号已发送" }
```

or `cancelled: false` if not currently inflight. Bad UUID → `400`; unknown id → `404`.

**Cancel is cooperative:** checked before and after `spawn_blocking` work. Mid-tokenization is **not** aborted. If cancel wins after work finishes, client may get `499` and the result is discarded.

### 4.5 `RequestRow` fields

| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `id` | UUID string |
| `created_at` / `started_at` / `finished_at` | timestamps; latter two optional |
| `status` | `queued` \| `running` \| `succeeded` \| `failed` \| `cancelled` |
| `client_ip` | optional |
| `text_count` | count of **non-empty locale values** across all maps (not `texts.len()`) |
| `input_chars` | sum of char counts of non-empty values |
| `output_chars` | sum of `results[i].chars().count()` on success |
| `langs` | sorted unique engine labels joined by `,` e.g. `ja,latin,zh` |
| `duration_ms` | optional |
| `error` | optional |

---

## 5. Errors

Uniform JSON:

```json
{ "code": "<CODE>", "message": "<string>" }
```

| HTTP | `code` | When |
|------|--------|------|
| 400 | `BAD_REQUEST` | validation / bad UUID / JSON issues |
| 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` | auth |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | missing request |
| 499 | `CANCELLED` | cancelled while handling tokenize |
| 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` | DB / semaphore / join failures |

`message` is often Chinese (from `thiserror` Display).

---

## 6. Environment

| Variable | Required | Default | Meaning |
|----------|----------|---------|---------|
| `TOKENIZER_TOKEN` | **yes** | — | Bearer secret (missing → panic on boot) |
| `TOKENIZER_BIND` | no | `0.0.0.0:8080` | listen address |
| `TOKENIZER_DB_PATH` | no | `/data/tokenizer.db` | SQLite path (local: `./data/tokenizer.db`) |
| `TOKENIZER_MAX_CONCURRENCY` | no | CPU logical cores (fallback 4) | CPU-bound tokenize semaphore |
| `TOKENIZER_MAX_BODY_MB` | no | `8` | request body limit |

Build/run tip: Lindera dict fetch often needs:

```bash
./scripts/fetch-lindera-dicts.sh
export LINDERA_CACHE="$PWD/.lindera-cache"
```

Logging: `RUST_LOG` / tracing `EnvFilter` (default `tokenizer_service=info,tower_http=info`).

---

## 7. Request lifecycle (`POST /api/tokens`)

```text
validate texts
→ UUID + insert_request (queued) + client IP
→ register_inflight(CancellationToken)
→ acquire cpu_sem
→ if cancelled → mark_cancelled → 499
→ mark_running
→ spawn_blocking: for each map → tokens_from_map
→ if cancelled → mark_cancelled → 499
→ mark_succeeded(output_chars, duration_ms)
→ remove_inflight
→ 200 + results + x-request-id + x-duration-ms
```

Concurrency: at most `TOKENIZER_MAX_CONCURRENCY` tokenize jobs in blocking pool at once; excess wait on semaphore.

---

## 8. Repo map (for code changes)

```
src/
  main.rs          # router: public vs protected
  config.rs        # env loading
  auth.rs          # Bearer middleware
  error.rs         # AppError → HTTP + JSON
  state.rs         # AppState, semaphore, inflight cancel map
  tokenize.rs      # TokenizerEngine, locale_kind, tokens_from_map, summarize_texts
  db.rs            # SQLite schema + request log CRUD
  docs.rs          # OpenAPI / Swagger description
  routes/
    tokens.rs      # POST /api/tokens only
    admin.rs       # stats, list, get, cancel
    health.rs      # GET /health
static/
  index.html       # panel
  test.html        # calls /api/tokens, reads data.results
  llms.txt         # this file (also GET /llms.txt)
```

Key symbols:

- `TokenizerEngine::tokens_from_map` — single-item tokenization
- `tokens_handler` — HTTP one-to-one loop
- `summarize_texts` — metrics for DB (`text_count`, `langs`, `input_chars`)

---

## 9. Gotchas (read before integrating)

1. **No batch endpoint.** Put up to 500 maps in one `texts` array.
2. **Aligned empty strings.** Empty or all-skipped maps still consume a `results` slot.
3. **Multi-locale order unstable.** Do not snapshot-test exact token order across locales in one map without sorting.
4. **Casing asymmetry.** Latin lowercased; CJK surfaces kept; dedupe uses lowercase keys.
5. **`zh` matching is prefix.** `zhHans` (no hyphen) still → Chinese; `cmn` must be exact.
6. **Cancel race.** Possible `499` after work completed; do not assume cancel only when idle.
7. **Meta headers only on success** of `/api/tokens`.
8. **CORS** is wide open (any origin/method/header) — do not rely on browser CORS for security; Bearer is the gate.
9. **Dead code warning:** `db::mark_failed` may be unused; harmless unless you wire failure paths.

---

## 10. Breaking changes already applied (do not regress)

| Legacy | Current |
|--------|---------|
| `POST /api/tokens` merged all maps → one `tokens` string | one-to-one → `results[]` |
| `POST /api/tokens/batch` with nested `items: Vec<Vec<Map>>` | **removed** |
| Docs framed as Meilisearch document merge | generic tokenizer service |

If a caller still sends old shapes or expects `data.tokens`, update the caller.

---

## 11. Suggested checks after your change

```bash
# Compile
cargo check

# Run (example)
mkdir -p data
export LINDERA_CACHE="$PWD/.lindera-cache"
set -a && source .env && set +a
cargo run

# Smoke
curl -s http://localhost:8080/health
curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/tokens \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKENIZER_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"texts":[{"en-US":"Hello"},{"ja":"テスト"}]}'
```

Expect HTTP 200 and JSON `results` length 2.

---

## 12. What this service is not

- Not a general NLP pipeline (no POS filtering, stemming, or ranking beyond space-join).
- Not a search engine; it only produces token strings.
- Not multi-tenant beyond shared Bearer secret.
- Not streaming; full request body then full response.
